text_copy_copy.text: CONTACT US

text_copy_copy_copy.text: KEY FEATURES
SYSTEM OFFERINGS

text_681423834.text:
The Ortholoc 3Di Foot Reconstruction Plating System is a multi-indication foot reconstruction solution providing indication specific implants and instruments designed to address the unique demands of the forefoot and midfoot.


Each Ortholoc 3Di implant has been designed with a focus on strength, versatility, and low-profile anatomic contours. Additionally, the employment of the Ortholoc 3Di Polyaxial Locking Technology allows the surgeon the option of 2.7mm or 3.5mm locking screws capable of locking at up to 15˚ off axis to the plate.

text_copy.text:
Key features

  • The Hallux, midfoot, and flatfoot plating options
  • 2.7 and 3.5mm locking and non-locking screws
  • Color-coded instrumentation for easy identification
  • CT-generated, multi-thickness anatomic plate designs

System offerings

3Di Hallux Module

The Hallux module of the Ortholoc 3Di Foot Reconstruction Plating System focuses on implant solutions related to indications and procedures of the first ray. The implants included in this module are designed to provide versatile plating options for first MTP fusions, Lapidus procedures, opening base wedge osteotomies, and other bunion osteotomies.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
MTP Fusion

16 MTP Fusion plate designs, 4 screw types, and polyaxial locking capability for surgical versatility.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Lapidus Fusion

Lapidus Fusion Plates feature 0-4mm plantar step-off designs to support controlled correction.

Proximal Opening Wedge

Low-profile BOW (Base Opening Wedge) plates feature a 1mm profile and 0-5mm wedge spacer options, to support IM angle correction.

3Di Midfoot Module

The Midfoot module of the Ortholoc 3Di Foot Reconstruction Plating System focuses on implant solutions related to joint arthrodesis and stabilizations of the midfoot and medial column.
Medial Column Plate
U-Plate
Straight Plate
T-Plate
N/C Plate

Medial Column Fusion

Navicular-Cuneiform and Medial Column Fusion Plate designs allow for multiplanar screw configurations, designed to promote rotational stability and resistance to pull-out strength.

TMT Fusion

Low-profile U-plates, Straight Plates, and T-Plates are designed to match the curvature of the midfoot anatomy, while providing multiple options for TMT fixation.

3Di Flatfoot Module

The Flatfoot module of the Ortholoc 3Di Foot Reconstruction Plating System focuses on implant solutions related to joint arthrodesis, stabilizations, and osteotomies. The implants included in this module are designed to provide versatile plating options for an array of fusions and osteotomies.
Evans Osteotomy plate
Cotton Osteotomy plate
Medial Displacement Calcaneal Osteotomy (MDCO) plate

Medial Displacement Calcaneal Osteotomies

MDCO plate instrumentation allows for correction that can be versatile for each patient.

Evans and Cotton Wedge Osteotomies

Evans and cotton plate designs each feature 4 different wedge options, allowing for varying degrees of correction and use of other wedges.

text_copy_copy.text:
Screws

The Ortholoc 3Di Locking hole has been designed to accept the 2.7mm and 3.5mm Ortholoc 3Di locking and non-locking screws. Choose the most appropriate screw diameter and type based on anatomy, bone quality, and surgical goals.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
2.7mm Locking screw

  • On-axis and polyaxial locking capability
  • Cortical bone thread
  • 2.0mm pre-drill
  • 10 – 30mm lengths

2.7mm Low-profile screw

  • Low-profile head sits flush with plate
  • Cortical bone thread
  • 2.0mm pre-drill
  • 10 – 30mm lengths

3.5mm Locking screw

  • On-axis and polyaxial locking capability
  • Cortical bone thread 
  • 2.8mm pre-drill
  • 10 – 60mm lengths

3.5mm Low-profile screw

  • Low-profile head sits flush with plate
  • Cortical bone thread 
  • 2.5mm pre-drill
  • 10 – 60mm lengths

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Color coding

The Ortholoc 3Di Core Set features an instrument and implant color coding system designed to increase O.R. efficiency and speed. After choosing the appropriate screw for a given application, select the drill and drill guide with the corresponding color coded markings.
